# Suits.me

> Suits.me is a personal custom-tailoring storefront based in New York. Customers choose a fabric, refine the garment details, and build a measurement profile so clothing is made to their measurements.

## What the site offers

- Collections for suits, jackets, trousers, shirts, weddings and women's clothing.
- Garment customization (fabric, pattern, lapel and other details) with a 3D garment preview.
- Guided adult and child measurement profiles, in inches or centimeters, that can be saved in the browser.
- Fit support and consultation preparation, including garment-clone guidance.

## Important notes for accuracy

- The current site is a preview experience. Configurations and prices shown are illustrative, and online payment and production orders are not yet connected.
- The storefront is served at https://suits.me/, and its views have real URLs of their own: collections live under https://suits.me/collections/ (for example https://suits.me/collections/suits/wool-suits), and each product has its own page at https://suits.me/product/ followed by its product id. The older in-page hash links open the same views.

## Links
